# Case Agents: the wrong tool is not an acceptable approach 

> Markdown (GEO/AEO) version of <https://mauricio.issei.com.br/en/case-agents>. Author: **Mauricio Yokoyama Issei** · en-BR · Published: 2026-09-10 · Updated: 2026-09-10.

## In short

O **case-agents** is the implementation and benchmark of a routing brain for banking agent: decides if a query needs LLM, selects 2 tools between 285 registered and **blocks execution when the decision is not reliable enough**.

- **The ability is to choose the right tool; trust is to know when not to execute any.**
- **Catalog governance** — collapse of semantic duplicates in 14 canonical capabilities raised Hit Rate@2 from 35% to 100%.
- **The Silent Crash contained** — the Board of Directors (reading vs writing) prevented an e-mail consultation from changing the client's record.
- **Real cost savings** — 77.8% of economy with 100% success in executions.

## The problem and the domain

In the banking field, executing a wrong tool in the customer account is unacceptable. The routing brain needs to decide safely and abstain when confidence is insufficient.

## The barrier and the results

Four layers of security led the incorrect executions from 7 to zero, keeping 100% right in the 20 transactional queries and 77.8% cost savings in the MVP benchmark.

## Frequently Asked Questions

**What is the Case Agents project?**

It is the development and evaluation of the brain routing and selection of tools of a digital banking service agent. It classifies the message in FAST PATH or AGENT, retrieves the 2 most relevant tools between 285 and applies a 4-layer pre-execution barrier before calling any LLM.

**What is Silent Crash measured in the project?**

A failure in which a query query ("What is the email registered in my account?") resolved with high confidence and slack margin (0.47) for the registration change tool (update email). The failure went through 54 tests and 3 traditional guards without generating exception.

**How does the steering guard work?**

The Direction Guard (G4) analyzes the query verb and compares it to the mode of operation (read/write) stated in the tool. If the query is read and the tool is written, the system completely discards the tool to prevent irreversible damage to the client's registration.

**How to achieve 100% success with cost savings?**

Declaring the governance of the tool catalog (collapse of semantic duplicates in canonical capabilities) and applying the 4-layer pre-execution barrier (router confidence, minimum score, relative margin and direction). Net cost savings were 77.8%.

## Glossary

- **Pre-Execution Barrier** — Set of 4 deterministic guards authorising or diverting the execution of a tool before invoking the LLM.
- **Steering Guard** — Semantic restriction that prevents writing tools (state change) in read requests.
- **Capacity Collapse** — Grouping of redundant operational variants under a unique canonical capacity.
